RAVDESS — dataset analysis

1,440 recordings · 24 actors · 88.8 minutes. Validated audio decoding and finite samples. Found 1 byte-identical recording pairs, all within the same split. 1 files contain samples at or above 0.999 amplitude. Metadata and file-health checks cover all files; illustrative features use training actors.

Emotion balance by split

Neutral has one intensity level; the other emotions have two. Split assignment depends only on actor IDs.

Actor coverage

Each actor belongs to exactly one split. This prevents recordings from the same voice appearing in both training and testing.

Recording lengths

These are original file durations, before trimming and the model’s four-second crop or padding.

Duration and amplitude

Amplitude differences can reflect the recording or performance and do not establish emotion on their own.

Log-mel examples from training actors

One original-duration example per emotion. Colors show decibels relative to the peak of each recording.
